tools.name: search
tools.description: Search FxLayer's compliance guides and the RBI purpose-code reference with plain words (for example 'EDPMS entry not closed', 'Form 145 Part C', 'software export purpose code'). Returns ids for `fetch`.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: The full text (Markdown) of a guide or a purpose-code page, by the id `search` returned (guide:<slug>, code:<code>) or by its address on fxlayerhq.com.

tools.name: find_purpose_codes
tools.description: RBI purpose codes that fit a payment or receipt described in plain words, best first, each with its bank form (Form A1 / A2), Form 145 / 146, income-tax nature, GST and reporting.

tools.name: get_purpose_code
tools.description: One RBI purpose code (e.g. P0802, S1006) with the reasoning: which bank form, income-tax nature and Form 145 / 146 part, GST, reporting, cautions and the matching code for the other direction.

tools.name: export_realisation_deadline
tools.description: The last day to realise and repatriate an export's proceeds under FEMA (for exports from 1 October 2026, nine months from the date of export, or twelve when invoiced or settled in rupees), with the rule and its source.

tools.name: services_edf_due_date
tools.description: When the monthly EDF for a services export invoice is due (30 days from the end of the month of invoicing, for invoices from 1 October 2026), with the rule and its source.

tools.name: regulatory_updates
tools.description: The RBI / FEMA / income-tax / GST changes FxLayer follows: the rule, when it takes effect, its source and what changed in FxLayer. Newest first.

tools.name: about_fxlayer
tools.description: What FxLayer is, its modules, plans with starting prices, and where to sign up or read more.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "export_realisation_deadline" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "The last day to realise and repatriate an export's proceeds under FEMA (nine months from the date of export, twelve when invoiced in rupees, from 1 October 2026), with the rule and its source." → after: "The last day to realise and repatriate an export's proceeds under FEMA (for exports from 1 October 2026, nine months from the date of export, or twelve when invoiced or settled in rupees), with the rule and its source."

remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
